roleNote: An example of what you can build from kit components. Start from it, change it, or ignore it; layout is your choice. Follow `must` (kit look and accessibility); `defaults` are this example's suggestions, change any of them.
copyNote: Not exported from agentic-ds-kit. add copies the source into your app (components/patterns/sign-in/) with this contract beside it. You own the copy: replace the demo data, rearrange or drop sections, and keep the `must` lines.
intent: Sign-in / sign-up page example: centred Card (title is the page h1) with SSO on top, a Divider "or use email", Field-wrapped email and password, one primary submit, and a one-time code step on InputOTP. Presentational: the app passes callbacks and moves the step.

mode.note: sign-up adds a Name field, drops Remember me and Forgot password, and swaps the copy.

step.note: credentials: SSO, email and password. code: a 6-digit one-time code on InputOTP md (groups [3, 3], autoComplete one-time-code) with Verify. The app sets it after onSubmit when the account needs a code.

providers.note: { id, label, icon? } — secondary block Buttons above the form, over Divider label="or use email". icon is any Lucide name or a Lucide component (same as Button iconStart). Omit for email only.

onSubmit.note: (values: { email, password, name?, remember? }) => void. Called only after required and email-format checks pass.

onVerifyCode.note: (code: string) => void. Called from the code step only after all 6 digits are entered.

onForgotPassword.note: Shows 'Forgot password?' (tertiary sm) in sign-in mode.

onSwitchMode.note: (next: mode) => void. Shows the footer switch button. Left out, sign-in shows an invite line ("No account? Ask your admin for an invite.") instead of Sign up.

error.note: Server failure: { title, detail? } (what happened, what to do next) or a plain string. Credentials step: danger Alert (title + detail) above the form, the description hides, the password clears and focus moves to it, email stays. Code step: the code Field's error (title and detail joined), the slots clear and focus moves to them.

loading.note: Primary disabled with a busy label (Signing in…, Verifying…); SSO and code slots disabled; form aria-busy.

requirements: Card headingLevel 1: the card title is the page's one h1 ("Sign in", then "Enter your code")
Tab order: SSO → (name) → email → password → remember → forgot → primary → footer button; below --grid-breakpoint-sm Forgot sits after the primary
Enter in any input submits (form with a type=submit primary)
Autocomplete: email username, password current-password (new-password on sign-up), code one-time-code with inputmode numeric
Validation errors go through Field error; focus moves to the first invalid input
A server error clears the password and moves focus to it (email kept); on the code step it clears the code and focuses it. Moving to the code step focuses the code; moving back focuses Password
The form is noValidate so browser bubbles never replace Field errors

must: Use kit components from agentic-ds-kit for anything the kit has; no local cousins (tables, dialogs, rows, rules, charts)
Semantic tokens only (agentic-ds-kit/tokens.css); no raw hex, no primitive --color-* ramps
One appearance="solid" mode="primary" Button per step (Sign in, then Verify); SSO buttons are outline-neutral, forgot and switch are ghost-neutral
Do not restyle kit components; change them through their props, slots, and tokens
Wrap every labeled input in Field (label, hint, and error wiring)

Render inside a main landmark (wrap the pattern, or your page content, in <main>); header and nav chrome, if any, use AppHeader / SideNav (or other header / nav landmarks) and nav stays reachable on small screens
Submit is a type=submit Button inside the form (Enter submits), not a Card footer action
Providers render above the email form, separated by Divider label="or use email"
defaults: A full page on surface.page with no app chrome (no AppHeader or SideNav); put it in your own layout if you prefer
Presentational: pass callbacks (onSubmit, onVerifyCode, onProvider, …); wire your own auth, never store credentials in the component
A 400 wide card; size sm below --grid-breakpoint-sm with Forgot password moved under Sign in
"Stay signed in 30 days" instead of Remember me, and an invite line instead of a Sign up footer
snippet: <SignInPattern productName="Northwind Billing" step={step} providers={[{ id: "sso", label: "Continue with company SSO", icon: "Lock" }]} onSubmit={(values) => signIn(values)} onVerifyCode={(code) => verify(code)} onProvider={(id) => sso(id)} onForgotPassword={() => {}} error={error} />
